note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 5 June 1952. The Belfast Telegraph nomination report (20 May 1952) lists all nine divisions: contests expected in Ballysillan and Whitehouse, single nominees elsewhere, including the new member Thomas Clifford for Ballygomartin. Sole nominee; the paper says Ballygomartin has returned a new council member unopposed. Returned unopposed.
